notes.title: Rise of the Triad: Ludicrous Edition update adds cross-platform multiplayer, another cut character, and more
notes.notes: Ye olde 1990s knockabout shooter Rise of the Triad was remastered and rereleased as Rise of the Triad: Ludicrous Edition last year. As our Shaun Prescott said at the time, it hasn't aged well but you should still play it. It's a goofball historical artifact with some fun power-ups and more hidden doors than Castle Dracula, and it's just received an update... Read more.
